entries.title: A task's summary opens when the keyboard reaches its key while the card is still settling
entries.body: When you move onto a task key in a card with the keyboard just as the card is still easing into place, the task's summary now opens beside the key. Before, on a busy computer, it could stay closed until you moved off the key and back.
entries.noPicture: This changes when the existing summary opens, not how any view looks.
